main_idea: AQ-data warmup lifts Nemotron 3 Ultra's GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7.
ideas: Warmup nearly closes gap to teacher
Ultra has ~6x throughput of open models
summary: A solid bar chart is cluttered by three stat cards (two repeat the bars, one is an unrelated throughput claim), a blog tag, a footer URL and wordy sublabels.
defects: Stat card text overflows the bottom of the middle and right cards
Footnote wraps and sits close to the URL
